title: ArmChandelierPayload
description: Phase 4: signal payload to PositionWorkflow.arm_chandelier. Dispatched by CopytradeSignalWorkflow's STC branch when trail_on_partial is true. Idempotent — a second arm on an already-armed position is a silent no-op.

source_signal_id.description: signal_id of the STC line that triggered the arm. Recorded for audit forensics.

peak_premium.description: Initial peak premium to anchor the trail at. Typically the STC ref_premium at arm time.

giveback_pct.description: Trailing-stop giveback fraction. fire_threshold = peak * (1 - giveback_pct).
